findings.summary: RSA records 66 smart tachograph infringements at roadside checks - HGV Ireland RSA records 66 smart tachograph infringements at roadside checks John Loughran Policy & Compliance November 10, 2026 The Road Safety Authority (RSA) has reported 66 infringements during roadside inspections for failing to have a smart tachograph fitted, highlighting the need for Irish hauliers to check vehicles used on international work. The figure is a reminder that transport managers should confirm the equipment fitted to each vehicle before assigning it to a cross-border journey. Having a digital tachograph, or even a first-generation smart unit, does not necessarily satisfy the retrofit requirements. Under the EU Mobility Package, affected HGVs operating internationally must now be equipped with a Smart Tachograph Version 2 . The retrofit deadlines for both older analogue and digital non-smart units, and Version 1 smart tachographs, have passed. Which deadlines applied? Vehicles used internationally that were fitted with an analogue or digital non-smart tachograph had to be upgraded by 31 December 2024 . Those equipped with a Smart Tachograph Version 1 unit had until 18 August 2025 to complete the replacement. New in-scope heavy vehicles first registered from 21 August 2023 were already required to have Version 2 equipment. The distinction matters when reviewing fleet records: a truck described as having a “smart tachograph” may still have a Version 1 unit requiring replacement for international operations. Britain and Northern Ireland journeys are covered The RSA confirms that goods vehicles carrying a load between Ireland and the UK, including Northern Ireland, must meet the relevant retrofit requirements unless an existing exemption applies. findings.title: Irish Road Haulage, Transport & Commercial Vehicle News
findings.summary: Irish hauliers face further M6 disruption as major resurfacing works continue into summer 2027 - HGV Ireland Irish hauliers face further M6 disruption as major resurfacing works continue into summer 2027 John Loughran Irish Haulage News November 5, 2026 Irish hauliers travelling through north-west England are being advised to prepare for further disruption on the M6 motorway, with National Highways confirming an extensive resurfacing programme between junctions 16 and 19 that will continue until summer 2027. The works, which began on 14 October 2026, cover a strategically important section of the motorway between Crewe and Knutsford in Cheshire. The programme involves overnight lane and slip-road closures, potentially affecting Irish transport operators travelling between the Holyhead ferry port, the English Midlands, Manchester, northern England and Scotland. With restrictions scheduled to remain in place for several months, transport managers will need to factor possible delays into delivery schedules, drivers’ hours and ferry connections. Overnight restrictions between Crewe and Knutsford National Highways has confirmed that the resurfacing programme will involve overnight lane and slip-road closures between 9pm and 6am. The restrictions will apply on weekdays and weekends throughout the project, although the precise locations and arrangements may change as work progresses. Where closures require diversions, alternative routes will be clearly signposted. National Highways has not published a single fixed diversion route for the entire programme, meaning drivers and transport managers will need to check the latest restrictions before travelling. The work is scheduled to continue until summer 2027, subject to operational requirements and weather conditions. Important f
findings.searchSummary: National Highways is running a resurfacing programme on the M6 between junctions 16 and 19 in north-west England, expected to continue until summer 2027. The lead warns of possible delays and effects on drivers' hours and turnaround times for hauliers travelling through the area.

findings.title: Sicurezza nei cantieri autostradali: il nuovo CdS vieta il sorpasso ai camion
findings.summary: Home News Codice della Strada e Leggi Coni lavori in corso Nuovo CdS: vietato ai camion il sorpasso nei cantieri autostradali. Multe da 170 a 680 euro e 20 metri di distanza minima dal veicolo davanti. Nuovo CdS: vietato ai camion il sorpasso nei cantieri autostradali. Multe da 170 a 680 euro e 20 metri di distanza minima dal veicolo davanti. di Raffaele Dambra 9 Novembre 2026 - 18:25 Chi viaggia in autostrada conosce bene il restringimento di carreggiata, le corsie ridotte e i mezzi pesanti che avanzano a pochi metri dai lavori in corso . Sono i tratti in cui basta un attimo di disattenzione per trasformare un normale spostamento in un incidente. Lo schema di decreto legislativo del nuovo Codice della Strada , attualmente in esame parlamentare, interviene proprio su questo punto con una stretta mirata: nei cantieri i camion non potranno più effettuare sorpassi . Non si tratta di un divieto generalizzato sulle autostrade, ma di una regola legata alla presenza dei lavori. IL DIVIETO DI SORPASSO PER I MEZZI PESANTI La norma è contenuta nell’ articolo 55 comma 11 , e riguarda i veicoli destinati al trasporto merci con massa a pieno carico superiore a 3,5 tonnellate . Nei cantieri su autostrade e strade extraurbane principali questi mezzi non potranno superarne altri , nemmeno quando restano aperte due o più corsie, salvo diversa segnalazione. La novità sta nel criterio: finora il divieto scattava solo dove era imposto dalla segnaletica, mentre con il nuovo testo sarebbe la semplice presenza del cantiere a far scattare la restrizione . Per chi viola la regola è prevista una sanzione da 170 a 680 euro. findings.title: Wegen AK-Studie WK Tirol warnt vor höheren Lkw-Mauten und Folgen für Betriebe
findings.summary: Die Wirtschaftskammer Tirol kritisiert Forderungen nach weiteren Lkw-Mauterhöhungen. Sie sieht Risiken für Unternehmen, Arbeitsplätze und Preise. TIROL. Die Diskussion um die Höhe der Lkw-Maut sorgt erneut für Kontroversen. Die Wirtschaftskammer Tirol spricht sich klar gegen weitere Erhöhungen aus und verweist auf die bereits hohen Belastungen für die Transportbranche. WK-Tirol-Präsidentin Barbara Thaler betont, dass Tirol bereits heute zu den Regionen mit den höchsten Mautkosten Österreichs zählt. Besonders auf dem Abschnitt zwischen Kufstein und dem Brenner seien die Tarife bereits sehr hoch. „In Tirol, auf dem Abschnitt zwischen Kufstein und Brenner, haben wir die höchsten Mauttarife Österreichs. Für internationale Frächter ist Tirol oft nur eine Etappe auf einer langen Strecke. Für unsere Transporteure und Betriebe sind es die Straßen, auf denen sie täglich unterwegs sind. Zusätzliche Kosten können die Kleineren im internationalen Wettbewerb oft nicht weitergeben – das bestätigt sogar die aktuelle AK-Studie. Wer die Mauttarife weiter erhöht, riskiert, dass heimische Betriebe vom Markt verdrängt werden. Und gerade die Arbeiterkammer sollte wissen: Wenn unsere Betriebe auf der Strecke bleiben, stehen auch Arbeitsplätze vor Ort auf dem Spiel“, warnt Barbara Thaler. Transporteure sehen Belastungsgrenze erreicht Auch die Tiroler Transportwirtschaft sieht weitere Erhöhungen kritisch. Neben den Mauttarifen hätten die Unternehmen bereits mit steigenden Personal-, Energie-, Fahrzeug- und Finanzierungskosten zu kämpfen. Für den Obmann der Fachgruppe Güterbeförderung in der Wirtschaftskammer Tirol, Ulf Schmid, wäre eine zusätzliche Belastung schwer verkraftbar. „Unsere Betriebe sind bereits an ihrer wirtschaftlichen Belastungsgrenze. Höhere Mautkosten bleiben nicht ohne Folgen

findings.title: Irish Road Haulage, Transport & Commercial Vehicle News
findings.summary: Holyhead customs shake-up planned for 2027 - HGV Ireland Holyhead customs shake-up planned for 2027 John Loughran Shipping & Logistics November 4, 2026 Irish hauliers using the busy Dublin–Holyhead freight corridor face changes to UK customs arrangements from early 2027, following confirmation by HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC) that border checks are expected to move from the existing inland facility to infrastructure within Holyhead Port. The planned changes form part of a wider UK Government strategy to transfer responsibility for customs infrastructure from temporary, government-funded inland border facilities to port operators. In guidance updated on 26 October 2026, HMRC confirmed that it intends to move customs checks currently undertaken through the Holyhead Inland Border Facility (IBF) to infrastructure provided by the port operator within Holyhead Port. However, the precise implementation timetable and detailed operating arrangements have yet to be finalised. For Irish hauliers, the announcement raises important questions about how customs inspections will be managed, whether vehicle movements through the port will change and what impact the new arrangements could have on journey times. GOV.UK+1 Why Holyhead matters to Irish hauliers Holyhead is one of the most important gateways for Irish road freight entering Britain, with regular ferry services linking the Welsh port with Dublin. The route provides Irish transport operators with access to markets across Britain and forms an important part of the UK landbridge used by some operators travelling onwards to continental Europe. For hauliers operating to tight delivery schedules, any changes to customs procedures can have significant operational implications. Additional waiting time, altered vehicle routing or delays

findings.summary: In Umsetzung A565 Brücke Sanierung Rheinbrücke Bonn-Nord Die Rheinbrücke Bonn-Nord wurde im Jahr 1967 gebaut. Sie besteht aus der linksrheinischen Vorlandbrücke, der Strombrücke und der rechtsrheinischen Vorlandbrücke. Aufgrund der begrenzten Restnutzungsdauer der Rheinbrücke Bonn-Nord muss die Rheinquerung erneuert werden. Übersicht Sperrung Rheinbrücke Bonn-Nord Die Rheinbrücke Bonn-Nord (Friedrich-Ebert-Brücke) wurde deshalb am 3. Juni um 15 Uhr vorsorglich zur Sicherheit aller Verkehrsteilnehmenden vollständig gesperrt. Die Rheinbrücke Bonn-Nord (Friedrich-Ebert-Brücke) wird ab heute (3.6.) um 15 Uhr vorsorglich voll für den Kraftfahrzeugverkehr gesperrt. Die Sperrung betrifft nicht nur das Bauwerk selbst, sondern die folgenden Abschnitte der A565 zwischen dem Autobahnkreuz Bonn-Nord und dem Autobahndreieck Bonn-Nordost. In Fahrrichtung Koblenz: Sperrung zwischen dem Dreieck Bonn-Nordost und dem Kreuz Bonn-Nord, d.h. es sind keine Überfahrten mehr von der A59 aus Köln und Königswinter kommend auf die A565 nach Koblenz möglich. Die Anschlussstellen Bonn-Beuel und -Auerberg sind ebenfalls gesperrt. In Fahrtrichtung Siegburg: Sperrung zwischen dem Kreuz Bonn-Nord und der Anschlussstelle Bonn-Beuel, d.h. im Kreuz Bonn-Nord sind sämtliche Verbindungen auf die A565 nach Siegburg gesperrt, die Anschlussstelle Bonn-Auerberg ebenfalls. In der Anschlussstelle Bonn-Beuel sind Auffahrten auf die A565 nach Siegburg weiterhin möglich. Aktuelle Brückenprüfungen haben strukturelle Schäden am Tragwerk der linksrheinischen Vorlandbrücke festgestellt, die eine unverzügliche Sicherung erfordern. Die bereits umgesetzten Maßnahmen – darunter ein Fahrverbot für Lkw über 7,5 Tonnen sowie technische Kontrollen (WIM-Anlagen) – haben nicht ausgereicht, um weitere Schäden zu verhindern. Dirk B

findings.title: Irish tolls rise from January: up to 30 cents more per HGV trip, and hauliers call it “extortion”
findings.summary: Key points: Tolls on all 10 national toll roads in Ireland will rise from 1 January 2027. Heavier HGVs will pay 20 to 30 cents more on the M50 and the PPP toll roads. The southbound Dublin Tunnel toll in the morning peak rises from €14 to €15; other tunnel rates stay unchanged. TII says tolls follow inflation, citing CPI of 3.6%. The IRHA wants the increases stopped or suspended, and protesters are considering action in Dublin in November. What changes from 1 January According to TII, as reported by the Irish public broadcaster RTÉ , the increases are: M50: +10 cents for cars with a tag or video account, +20 cents for unregistered cars; for heavier HGVs +20 or +30 cents, goods vehicles up to 2,000 kg: +10 cents for tag or unregistered users, +20 cents for video account users, PPP toll roads: +20 cents for HGVs and +30 cents for HGVs over 3,500 kg with four or more axles; on the M3 Clonee–Kells, HGVs pay 10 cents more, Dublin Tunnel: the southbound toll between 6am and 10am on weekdays rises from €14 to €15 ; all other tunnel rates are unchanged. For a car on the M50 with a tag account, the toll will be €2.70. Without an account, it will be €4.00. Why TII is raising tolls TII says the level of tolls is regulated through an inflation adjustment mechanism under the toll bye-laws. It cites consumer price inflation of 3.6% between August 2025 and August 2026. Toll income pays for the operation, maintenance and renewal of the national road network and supplements funding from the Exchequer. The Dublin Tunnel increase, TII says, “reflects the increasing volumes of traffic being experienced in southbound peak period”. The authority also wants to protect capacity for HGVs travelling to Dublin Port. Hauliers: “price gouging” The IRHA has reacted sharply. Its president, Ger Hyland
findings.searchSummary: Transport Infrastructure Ireland has confirmed increases on all 10 national toll roads from 1 January 2027. Heavier HGVs will pay 20 to 30 cents more per passage on the M50 and the PPP toll roads.

findings.title: Irish Road Haulage, Transport & Commercial Vehicle News
findings.summary: Irish HGV drivers reminded to check weights before travelling to Britain - HGV Ireland Irish HGV drivers reminded to check weights before travelling to Britain John Loughran HGV Guide November 7, 2026 Irish hauliers travelling to Britain are reminded to check vehicle and axle weights before departure, as an overload can leave a truck prohibited from continuing its journey. For operators working to tight delivery windows and ferry schedules, a roadside weight check can have consequences beyond an enforcement penalty. Correcting an overload may require goods to be transferred to another vehicle, adding cost and disrupting the remainder of the journey. The reminder concerns existing requirements, rather than a newly announced rule or enforcement campaign. Total weight is only part of the check Drivers and transport managers must establish that the loaded vehicle complies with the limits applicable to its configuration and route. Checking the overall weight alone is insufficient. Poor load distribution can overload an individual axle even where the vehicle remains within its permitted total weight. The Road Safety Authority’s professional driver guidance specifically reminds drivers to check the maximum permitted weights and dimensions of countries they visit or pass through, including the UK. It also highlights the need to check loads whenever goods are added or removed. www.rsa.ie That matters particularly on multi-drop work, where unloading changes the distribution of weight across the remaining load. Overloading can stop the journey The Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA) states that an overloaded vehicle will receive an immediate prohibition notice and may be immobilised. findings.title: Vrachtwagenheffing in Nederland
findings.summary: Home Wetswijzigingen Deze wet is ingegaan: zorg dat u aan de regels voldoet Deze wet is ingegaan. U moet aan de regels voldoen. De overheid controleert dit. Wat is er veranderd? Bent u eigenaar van een vrachtwagen? In Nederland is de vrachtwagenheffing op 1 juli 2026 gestart. Eigenaren van vrachtwagens betalen nu per gereden kilometer. Eigenaren van deze vrachtwagens moeten een bedrag per gereden kilometer betalen op: vrijwel alle snelwegen een aantal provinciale wegen een aantal gemeentelijke wegen De heffing geldt voor Nederlandse én buitenlandse voertuigen in de categorieën N2 en N3. Deze hebben een technische maximummassa (TMM) van meer dan 3.500 kilo. U vindt de voertuigcategorie op het kentekenbewijs. Het Eurovignet voor Nederland is gestopt op 1 juli 2026. Ook betaalt u geen motorrijtuigenbelasting voor vrachtwagens tot 12.000 kilo meer. En de motorrijtuigenbelasting voor vrachtwagens van 12.000 kilo en zwaarder is een stuk lager. In veel andere Europese landen geldde al een vrachtwagenheffing, zoals in Duitsland en België. Om vrachtwagenheffing te betalen, heeft u het volgende nodig: een contract met een aanbieder (dit kan vanaf begin 2026), de aanbieder stuurt u de rekening en geeft het geld door aan de overheid boordapparatuur (on-board-unit, OBU, tolkastje) die de afgelegde kilometers registreert, deze apparatuur krijgt u van de aanbieder De vrachtwagenheffing is bedoeld om eigenaren van een vrachtwagen uit Nederland en het buitenland te laten betalen per gereden kilometer. De heffing draagt ook bij aan het verduurzamen en efficiënter maken van de sector. Hoe schoner en lichter uw vrachtwagen(s), hoe lager het bedrag per kilometer. findings.searchSummary: The Netherlands introduced a per-kilometre truck charge on 1 July 2026 for N2 and N3 vehicles above 3,500 kg, including foreign vehicles. It applies to nearly all motorways and some provincial and municipal roads.

findings.title: Særtransport på Storebælt
findings.summary: Særtransport på Storebælt Klassificering Retningslinjer for passage af Storebæltsforbindelsen med køretøjer, der er klassificeret som særtransporter: Køretøjer med en bredde over 3,3 m Det er et krav, at du ringer til Storebælts O-rum på tlf. 58 30 30 50 senest 2 timer før passage. Køretøjer større end broklasse 100 og/eller bredere end 4,5 m Det er et krav, at du har en tilladelse fra Vejdirektoratet, og at du medbringer tilladelsen, når du passerer Storebæltsforbindelsen Langsomme transporter under 50 km/t Kontakt Storebælt senest 3 arbejdsdage før passage på mail s-transport@sbf.dk Det er ikke nødvendigt at kontakte Storebælt, hvis: • køretøjet er broklasse 100 eller derunder • køretøjet er 3,3 m bred eller derunder • akseltrykket er mindre end 12 t Bredderestriktioner Bredde Restriktion 2,8–4,5 m Passage skal ske til højre i betalingsanlægget (”Kontant” bane 10/20). Over 4,5 m Passage skal ske til højre i betalingsanlægget (”Kontant” bane 10/20). Transporten må kun gennemføres mellem kl. 22-6. Transportøren skal medbringe 2 ledsagevogne, som placeres bag transporten. Hvis transportens bredde er større end 5,4 m i vestgående retning eller 6,5 m i østgående retning, skal passage ske udenom betalingsanlægget via Halsskovvej. Vægtrestriktioner Vægt Restriktion Større end broklasse 100 Passage skal ske til højre i betalingsanlægget (”Kontant” bane 10/20). Transporten må kun gennemføres mellem kl. 22-6. Storebælts skriftlige transportrestriktioner skal følges. Hastighedsrestriktioner Hastighed Restriktion Hastighed mindre end 50 km/t Passage skal ske til højre i betalingsanlægget (”Kontant” bane 10/20). Transporten (evt. flere køretøjer i kolonne) må kun gennemføres mellem kl. 22.-6. Storebælt stiller med en ledsagevogn. Transporttilladelse Anøgning om særtransporttillade
findings.searchSummary: The Great Belt (Storebælt) bridge page sets passage requirements for oversize vehicles. Vehicles wider than 3.3 m must phone the Storebælt O-rum at least 2 hours before passage, and vehicles above bridge class 100 or wider than 4.5 m need a Vejdirektoratet permit to carry during crossing. Slow transports under 50 km/h must notify Storebælt at least 3 working days in advance.
